dynamic-search-bar-fixed.title: Dynamic Search Bar (push, not overlap)
dynamic-search-bar-fixed.description: Search/nav bar stays collapsed until hovered or focused (cmd+L), then expands and pushes the page down instead of overlapping it. Also removes the -16px root margin that left an unrendered strip at the bottom of the window.

remove-all-scrollbars.title: Remove All Scrollbars
remove-all-scrollbars.description: Hides every scrollbar in the client (sidebar, main view, panels, lyrics) while keeping scrolling fully functional.

hide-switch-to-video.title: Hide Switch to Video Button
hide-switch-to-video.description: Removes the 'Switch to video' button from the Now Playing view.

hide-playlist-column-header.title: Hide Playlist Column Header
hide-playlist-column-header.description: Removes the '# / Title / Album / Date added / Time' header row above playlist tracks.

hide-sort-and-collaborator.title: Hide Sort By & Add Collaborator
hide-sort-and-collaborator.description: Removes the sort dropdown and the invite-collaborators button from playlist pages.

hide-add-mix-details-row.title: Hide Add / Mix / Name & Details Row
hide-add-mix-details-row.description: Removes the entire Add / Mix / Name & details button row under the playlist header.

fix-duplicate-metadata-dots.title: Fix Duplicate Playlist Metadata Dots
fix-duplicate-metadata-dots.description: Spotify emits two adjacent bullet separators between the playlist owner and the song-count/duration, plus a trailing orphan bullet. This collapses them to a single separator.

liquid-lyrics-fill-npv.title: Liquid Lyrics Fill Now Playing Panel
liquid-lyrics-fill-npv.description: Makes the Liquid Lyrics card grow to fill the remaining height of the Now Playing panel instead of leaving empty space below it.

rotating-cover-art-optimized.title: Rotating Cover Art (Optimized)
rotating-cover-art-optimized.description: Spinning vinyl in the Now Playing view only. The playbar disc and song-card vinyl each forced every backdrop-filter surface to recompute per frame (~60pts of GPU).

hide-whats-new.title: Hide What's New Button
hide-whats-new.description: Removes the What's New button from the top bar.

lyrics-headerless-card.title: Liquid Lyrics Headerless Card
lyrics-headerless-card.description: Removes the Liquid Lyrics card's top bar (icon and title) and floats its three controls over the top-right of the lyrics at low opacity, giving the lyrics the full height of the card.

hide-home-button.title: Hide Home Button
hide-home-button.description: Removes the Home button from the top bar.
